faqs.a:
Application and annual license fees charged for liquor licenses shall be the maximum
               amounts specified in the Colorado Beer Code and Liquor Code (C.R.S. §§ 44-4-101 et
               seq. and 44-3-101 et seq.), and shall be paid to the city before the local licensing
               authority considers the application complete. Any fees not determined by the state
               will be determined by the city clerk.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
State Law reference—
Fermented malt beverage license fee, C.R.S. § 44-4-107; hotel and restaurant fee,
               C.R.S. § 44-3-411; alcoholic beverage license fees, C.R.S. § 44-3-505; special event
               permit fees, C.R.S. § 44-5-104.
